name: Our Responsibilities As Parents
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility parents have to intentionally nurture their children in the ways of the Lord. Deuteronomy 6:6 calls for God's commands to be deeply rooted in the parent's heart, guiding their teaching. Proverbs 22:6 highlights the importance of training children according to their path so they remain steadfast in righteousness throughout life. Fathers are specifically instructed in Ephesians 6:4 and Colossians 3:21 to avoid provoking their children to anger, instead raising them with loving discipline and godly instruction that encourages rather than discourages.
